subject: Hosted API integration - architecture review (SDKs, streaming, tool/function calling)
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@acme-corp.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: acme-infra@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Hosted API integration - architecture deep-dive

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found Redwood’s latency/cost points compelling. Our infra and platform teams want a focused architecture deep-dive to validate integration patterns (SDKs, streaming, and function/tool calling) before we finalize the pilot.

Can we schedule a 60-75 minute session the week of June 15? Ideal attendees from our side: me, our infra lead (acme-infra@acme-corp.com), and one app engineer. We'd like to cover:
- SDK best practices for reconnects, retries, and auth
- Streaming latency and chunking strategies for conversational UIs
- Tool/function calling patterns for external tool invocation and structured outputs
- Security: token rotation, KMS integration questions

Please propose a couple slots and any pre-read or agenda you want us to review.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Senior Platform Manager
Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API integration - architecture deep-dive

Hi Sam — great to hear the demo was useful. Happy to run the deep-dive. Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Tue Jun 15, 10:00–11:15 (60–75m)
- Wed Jun 16, 14:00–15:15 (60–75m)

I've attached a short draft agenda that maps your bullets to owners (SDKs: Dev Patel, Streaming/latency: Dylan Brooks, Security/KMS: Marissa). Please let us know which slot works and whether you want us to include an applied example (we can bring a small sample app showing streaming + function call flow).

Attachment: redwood-hosted-api-draft-agenda.pdf

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Park <sam.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-10T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API integration - architecture deep-dive

Adding a quick note from the SE side — for the agenda, I suggest we reserve a 15–20 minute live debugging slot where we show:
- A streaming conversation from SDK -> server with token refresh mid-session
- An example function-call invocation that triggers a webhook to an external tool (simulated) and returns structured JSON

If Acme can share one short example prompt or the domain of tools you expect to call (e.g., calendar/booking vs internal ticketing), we can tailor the live demo. Otherwise we'll use a generic inventory lookup + booking example.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Park <sam.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-infra@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-06-11T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API integration - architecture deep-dive

Thanks, Marissa and Dev. Wed Jun 16 at 14:00 PDT works better for our infra lead. One small change — we ran into a calendar conflict and will need to push by 30 minutes. Could we do 14:30–15:45 PDT on Jun 16 instead?

For the live demo, we'll prefer the inventory lookup + booking example (closest to our flow). Also, we'll send a short note on tokens and our KMS provider for your security section.

Apologies for the late tweak — hope 14:30 is ok.

Best,
Sam

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-12T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API integration - architecture deep-dive

14:30–15:45 PDT on Tue Jun 16 is confirmed — calendar invite sent (link below). We've updated the agenda to reflect the inventory lookup + booking demo and added a 15-minute QA window at the end.

Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456
Pre-read/drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/agenda_pdf_id
